subject: google/embeddinggemma-2
how_to_read: subject_rank is the position among models with complete results on that board only. Where subject_complete is false there is no comparable mean, so coverage is reported instead of a rank. `complete` holds every complete row on the board, so any rank can be re-derived and the models ahead are in `above`.

caveats.not_video: The registry lists video, but MVEB(v1) has no row for this model, so the post does not claim video.
caveats.partial_boards: MTEB(Europe), MTEB(Indic), MIEB(eng), MIEB(Multilingual), MIEB(Img) and ViDoRe are partial: the merged results cover some tasks and not others, so no mean is comparable. They appear with coverage and no rank.
caveats.parameter_counts: One ModelMeta covers several tower configurations (use_image / use_audio) and the results files record no tower config, so size is quoted once from the registry and never attached to a modality's score.
caveats.followir: FollowIR's main score is p-MRR: centred on zero, can be negative, and not comparable to an accuracy mean. It is why it is not in the card.
